headline: Broad rally lifts book +2.68%, IREN roars back
summary: A strong risk-on day carried the book higher on AMD and IREN strength, though MSFT keeps dragging and the book stays fully invested with only $42 in cash.
watch: AAPL at $312.68: a confirmed daily close ≥$317 triggers the queued $250 add; a break to $300 triggers the stop on any new buy — no position yet, both are entry-side triggers.
CRWD: still waiting on RSI ≤60 pullback before buying — not there yet.
PANW: RSI must fall to ≤70 before any new position is opened — do not chase above that level.
MSFT at -11.8% P/L with no stated stop — needs a hard invalidation level set given the continued weakness.
IREN: RSI 39.4 leaves room to extend, but confirm volume on any follow-through before adding — position is still -28.6%, do not average down.
Cash is down to $42 — any new trigger firing (CRWD, PANW, AAPL add) needs a funding decision, not just a signal.
recap: Book +2.68% to $12,448; cash at just $42 — essentially fully invested, no dry powder for new entries.
AMD +6.0% today, extending its lead to +9.2% P/L — the book's clear winner, RSI 57.3 not yet extended.
IREN +12.6% today but still -28.6% P/L overall — a sharp bounce off oversold (RSI 39.4), not confirmation of a trend reversal.
GEV +3.5%, now nearly breakeven at -0.6% P/L.
MSFT -1.1% today, remains the book's biggest laggard at -11.8% P/L with no bounce in sight.
NEE and SGOV flat/unchanged — no action needed there.
